Kaaya Unisex Salon

A premium unisex salon, built from the ground up — identity first, then a content engine that looked established from day one.

  • 0→1Full brand build from launch

challenge

Kaaya opened into a crowded local salon market. It needed to look premium and current immediately — not like a new business finding its feet.

approach

We designed the Kaaya identity and delivered it as a full brand book, then ran the content: bridal and glam reels, an AI facial reel, myth-vs-fact and FAQ carousels, and a nails testimonial reel — all on one visual system.

result

A salon brand that reads as established and premium, with a feed that stays consistent week to week.
